children: Hyperliquid Strategies entered into Amendment No. 3 to its ChEF Purchase Agreement with Chardan Capital Markets. The amendment revises pricing for additional common stock sales after the first 160,000,000 shares, setting the purchase price at 98.5% of VWAP for VWAP and Intraday VWAP Purchases, and 97.0% for Off-Hour VWAP Purchases, subject to adjustments. The change is intended to provide continued access to equity capital under defined, formula-based pricing.
: Amendment No. 3 to ChEF equity purchase agreement
: Optimize pricing for continued equity financing access

title: Hyperliquid Strategies Amends ChEF Equity Facility; Sets VWAP Pricing at 98.5%/97% After 160M Shares
